label: Simplified Chinese
source_guidance: Interpret Chinese ellipsis, contextual references and the relationship information carried by kinship terms.
target_guidance: Use Simplified Chinese and natural Chinese fiction conventions while preserving character voice and narrative rhythm.
punctuation_rule: Unless another explicit task format requires otherwise, preserve the structural role of punctuation and symbols. Ordinary stops and commas may follow Chinese word order. Do not omit quotation marks, brackets, questions, exclamations, colons, semicolons, dashes, ellipses, middle dots, tildes, slashes, asterisks, musical notes or other special symbols. Preserve their position, hierarchy, count, repetition and pairing. Use mainland Simplified Chinese full-width punctuation: ，。！？：；、, quotation marks “”‘’, ellipses …… and dashes ——. Do not retain half-width punctuation, Japanese 「」『』 or straight English quotes.
title_rule: Use concise titles following Chinese book and chapter conventions. Translate labels such as 第3章, 序章 and エピローグ by meaning as 第3章, 序章 and 尾声; do not transliterate them.
term_guidance: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
